query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
                          lc.quantite * COALESCE(lc.remplace_prix_unites, pf.prix_unites)
                      ) FILTER (WHERE lc.statut <> 'retiree'), 0)::bigint AS "montant!"
                 FROM commandes.ligne_commande lc
                 JOIN prestataires.prix_fige pf ON pf.id = lc.prix_fige_id
                WHERE lc.arret_id = $1
